official: 国民健康保険法施行条例の一部を改正する条例

sources.label: 令和8年第1回定例会 審議結果

name: 子ども・子育て支援納付金の算定方法を追加
summary: 条例に、子ども・子育て支援納付金の算定に関する規定を加えます。市町村ごとの算定に使う割合などを定め、被保険者均等割指数は0.7とします。
changes: 子ども・子育て支援納付金の所得係数を知事が定める方式にする
所得等割合と被保険者数等割合を、政令に定める市町村ごとの数とする
被保険者均等割指数を0.7とする
条例の附則第4項を削る
why: 国民健康保険法の一部改正などに伴い、県が市町村から徴収する納付金に、子ども・子育て支援納付金の算定規定を加えるためと、県は説明しています。

en.name: Adds rules for calculating child and child-rearing support contributions
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Ordinance for Enforcement of the National Health Insurance Act
en.summary: Adds provisions on calculating child and child-rearing support contributions to the ordinance. It sets the ratios and other figures used for calculations for each municipality, and sets the insured-person per-capita index at 0.7.
changes: Sets the income coefficient for child and child-rearing support contributions using a method determined by the governor
Sets the income-related share and insured-persons-related share at the figures for each municipality specified by Cabinet Order
Sets the insured-person per-capita index at 0.7
Deletes Paragraph 4 of the ordinance's supplementary provisions
en.why: The prefecture says this is to add rules for calculating child and child-rearing support contributions to the contributions it collects from municipalities, following partial amendments to the National Health Insurance Act and other changes.
